_help: Copy this file to feeds.config.json, edit it, then run: node server/ingest-feeds.js  (writes data/offers.json). Any value may contain ${ENV_VARS} so credentials never live in the repo. A feed 'source' is { "file": "..." } or { "url": "..." }. Each 'map' value is a COLUMN name from the feed, or a literal value if prefixed with '='. Set offersFile: 'data/offers.json' in config.js to use the result on the site.
_overridesHelp: Optional: pin a feed UPC/GTIN or SKU to an exact catalog product id for perfect matching.

feeds._docs: DISABLED EXAMPLE of a real affiliate-network feed (Impact / CJ / Rakuten / Awin / brand program). Set enabled:true, fill the URL + creds via env vars, and adjust the column map to the network's feed columns. 'deeplinkTemplate' wraps each product URL into your tracking link; {url} is URL-encoded and {keys} pull from 'params'.
